advancements.apotheosis.progression.asce: Equip a full set of Uncommon gear, slay an Invader and beat the Frontier Gateway to begin your Ascent
advancements.apotheosis.progression.summ: To reach the Summit, slay the Wither, equip a full set of Rare gear and beat the Ascent Gateway
advancements.apotheosis.progression.pinn: Entering the Pinnacle requires freeing the End, acquiring a full set of Epic gear and beating the Summit Gateway
